statement: For each actual F19--F25 inclusion mathcal K_sign <= R_sign <= V_sign, every proper finite scalar-affine marginal image reduces by an explicitly constructed conjugation and coefficient homomorphism to a representation into k0 semidirect D with full V translation group k0, full R image k0 semidirect C, and K image contained in ker(Tr_k0/k1) semidirect C, retaining the original scalar character. Proper affine images are equivalent to elements outside the trace-zero principal subspace of the exact trace-cocycle restriction kernel. The tensor/Frobenius coefficient isomorphism with explicit inverse identifies the remaining kernel problem with summed restrictions of m distinct characters and rank 6m+1 on 7m columns. For every finite coefficient field and continuous representation whose scalar values generate a field of order nine, the actual K and R images are equal. In particular equality holds for every map to Aff_1(F9), for both signs.
depends_on: F21 actual normal generation in D+; F22 actual marginal surjections and normal kernels; F23 literal completed source maps and explicit based sign transport; F24 all-character rank-one restriction injection and independently audited universal Laurent seed rows/source actions; F25 equal scalar-field affine images.
manuscript_passages: Part F root-adjoining intersection question; Section 30, folios 194-196, scans 383-387; Section 31, folios 198-199 verso, scans 391-394; original F7/F19 residual subgroup-membership reduction.
depends_on_doubtful_reading: None. Every source action, subgroup inclusion and sign comparison is the actual one retained in F19--F25.
computational_checks: Complete enumeration of (8^3-2^3)(2^4-1)=7560 F9 characters. The 64 F24 rows give exact ranks 11:8, 12:396, 13:7156 on 14 F3 columns. For all 404 remaining tuples, the eight seed rows have ranks 5:80, 6:284, 7:2, 8:38; closure under all 11 actual source matrices gives 12:50, 13:354 after one round, 13:404 after two rounds, and stability at the third round. Root independent audit imports neither producer and verifies all counts, principal vectors, action images, row spans and all nine identities Tr(i*z)=Im(z), using separate multiplicative-log evaluation and scalar incremental F3 elimination.
notes: All coefficient maps, trace-pairing nondegeneracy, affine conjugation and commutator formulas, continuity, inverse tensor/Frobenius map and actual sign transport are proved. Multiplication by i carries the computed imaginary-part kernel to the trace kernel and real principal parameters to trace-zero parameters. The scalar-field-nine result applies even when the original coefficient field is larger. General attainment of the arbitrary-field 6m+1 rank, full marginal equality and K+=D+ remain unresolved. Finite sample diagnostics over other fields and the exploratory source matrix algebra are not inputs to this claim.
